title: Tranquility on the Preserve | KEY.co
description_expanded: Outdoor living takes center stage with a private pool accented by a soothing waterfall and rain wall, a summer kitchen with grill and pizza oven, and inviting spaces for open-air dining and lounging. A separate carriage house with a game room, a projector screen, and a tap system adds another layer of entertainment and privacy. Located within a gated community with on-site security, guests also enjoy access to the sugar-white sands through deeded beach access, along with a community pool, park, and poolside bar and grill. With a four-seater golf cart, six adult bikes, and thoughtfully designed gathering spaces throughout, this home delivers a truly elevated WaterSound Beach experience.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
